Soul: drops, is collected and starts SkillBuerUse with an R press (toggled, 5 MP per second, sounds 0x1A5 and 0x92): two exported flames orbit Soma at a radius growing to 28 around a point 20 pixels above his feet (8 while crouching), turning by 0x200 a frame against his facing, each a -10, -10, 20 x 20 type-6 attack of power 12 + 12 / 8 * INT / 2 with elements 2; a second press shrinks the radius by 2 a frame, then ends it. Unit-tested and checked in local captures, not emulator-compared; the flames' timed type-6 sparkle trail and sub_08042A54(2, 0x18) are not ported. Sounds: its native PlaySong sites are all requested and unit-tested: 0x84 every ninth attack frame above 0x32 (sub_080CBC64) and the three 0x6E of its staged death (sub_080CBEA4); a local run rendered both through the mixer (not listened to). Animations: partial. Ported and unit-tested: the constructor (gravity 0x4000, signed halfword placement), the state-1 rolling movement and state-2 idle and attack with the native +0x18 angular spin, the source mode-2/mode-6 collision walker with the 0x08528B64 probe export, the paired graphics-only attack fires and the two timed fire projectiles, the linked fire's facing and coordinate follow, the state-4 inert lift, and the staged death with its flame scatter and eight terminal effects (offsets from local ROM metadata). Missing: the affine sprite and fire art fidelity (OAM not compared), the projectile frame collision boxes, the complete curved terrain masks and the palette callbacks; nothing is emulator-compared.
